verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies deletion control. CockroachDB exposes a SQL API for manipulating data, and its MCP server lets AI tools run write statements, so users could delete data. Backups with revision history and point-in-time restore relate to how data history is kept, but nothing documents retention policies as such. Missing for 10: documented retention controls (e.g., row-level TTL or automatic expiry), documented deletion and purge semantics including how deletion propagates to backups and revision history, managed-cloud data deletion and retention policy, and independent corroboration.
